mechanism: Methimazole can cause agranulocytosis and bone marrow suppression, which may increase metformin-associated lactic acidosis risk through reduced clearance and impaired immune function; additionally, methimazole may affect metformin renal clearance through altered thyroid function.
action: Monitor blood glucose closely and watch for signs of infection or lactic acidosis; regular CBC monitoring is warranted; consider alternative antithyroid agents if agranulocytosis develops.
